title: What resources are needed for optimal learning of bosonic Gaussian states?
abstract: arXiv:2603.18136v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Continuous-variable systems enable key quantum technologies in computation, communication, and sensing. Bosonic Gaussian states emerge naturally in various such applications, including gravitational-wave and dark-matter detection. A fundamental question is how to characterize an unknown bosonic Gaussian state from as few samples as possible. Despite decades-long exploration, the ultimate efficiency limit remains unclear. In this work, we study the necessary and sufficient number of copies to learn an $n$-mode Gaussian state, with energy less than $E$, to $\varepsilon$ trace distance with high probability. translated_title: 玻色高斯态的最优学习需要什么资源？
translated_abstract: 连续变量系统支撑着计算、通信和传感领域的关键量子技术。玻色高斯态在这类应用中自然出现，包括引力波和暗物质探测。一个基本问题是如何用尽可能少的样本表征未知的玻色高斯态。尽管经过数十年的探索，其最终的效率极限仍不明确。在本工作中，我们研究了以高概率将能量小于 $E$ 的 $n$ 模高斯态学习到 $\varepsilon$ 迹距离所需的充要副本数。我们证明了对于高斯测量，下界为 $\Omega(n^3/\varepsilon^2)$，在双重对数能量依赖性范围内与已知的最佳上界相匹配；对于任意测量，下界为 ${\Omega}(n^2/\varepsilon^2)$。我们进一步证明了，在给定高斯态满足某种承诺条件的情况下，存在 $\widetilde{O}(n^2/\varepsilon^2)$ 的上界。
tldr: 本文确定了学习能量受限的 n 模玻色高斯态所需的样本数下界——高斯测量为 Ω(n³/ε²)、任意测量为 Ω(n²/ε²)，并给出 Õ(n²/ε²) 的上界，基本解决了高斯态学习的样本复杂度问题。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes near-tight lower bounds on the number of copies required to learn energy-constrained n-mode bosonic Gaussian states—Ω(n³/ε²) for Gaussian measurements and Ω(n²/ε²) for arbitrary measurements—together with an upper bound of Õ(n²/ε²), essentially resolving the sample complexity of Gaussian state learning.
